name: cyberpsychosis-website
description: Cyberpsychosis official promotional & documentation website hosted on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run lint:tokens && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/build-site.ts && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/design-system/input.css -o dist/style.css --minify
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
